faqs.q: What platforms do you develop for?
faqs.a: We develop native apps for iOS and Android, as well as cross-platform solutions using React Native. The choice depends on your specific requirements, budget, and timeline.

faqs.q: How long does app development take?
faqs.a: A typical business app takes 10-15 days from start to launch. Complex applications with advanced features may require more time. We provide a detailed timeline during the planning phase.
Yes, we offer post-launch support and maintenance packages. The first 30 days of support are included, and we provide flexible monthly plans for continued updates and improvements.

faqs.q: Can you help with App Store submission?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We handle the entire submission process for both Apple App Store and Google Play Store, including optimization, compliance checks, and ongoing updates.
